qaChecks.assertion: In RTL Arabic text, technical IDs e1-e5 and h1-h3 stay left-to-right isolated and readable.
Legend and transcript identify observation, hypothesis and conflict by text and shape, not by color alone.
Evidence IDs e1-e5 and hypothesis IDs h1-h3 are never translated, transliterated, or localized.
Conflict, abstain, provisional and human-review states are never presented as a final cause or validated result.
Graph summaries and state changes use aria-live with svgTitle and svgDescription for screen readers.
All ref and label values render as escape-safe plain text with no HTML injection.
